notes.title: Zombie Outbreak 1943 is OUT NOW
notes.content: [p]Hello fans! [/p][p][/p][p]I'm pleased to announce Zombie Outbreak 1943 is OUT NOW.   The game features remastered weapon mechanics,  major graphics upgrades,  and all new maps and features that will bring you hours of entertainment.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're interested,  head on over to the store page and consider adding it to your wishlist,  or jump straight into the action and start fighting zombies right now! [/p][p][/p][p]There's a limited time launch discount that you can take advantage of by purchasing in the initial launch window,  something to consider if you want a generous discount! [/p][p][/p][p]  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3927150/Zombie_Outbreak_1943/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Zombie Outbreak 1942 has LAUNCHED!
notes.content:
Glowing eyes are seen in the distance,  and you start to hear the sounds of the undead approaching your location. You quickly scramble to find your pistol and barricade the windows as quickly as you can,  but unfortunately it's too late.  

A zombie outbreak is the last thing that you're expecting during World War II,  but now it is your new reality.  The only option you have left is to survive for as long as you can.
